description:
Available September · Student Property · Modern Apartment · City Centre Location · All Bills Inclusive Package Available

My Property Box are pleased to market this two bedroom apartment in the heart of the City Centre. Directly opposite Fenwicks Department Store, just moments away from the universities. The property is superbly located on one of the UK's prestige shopping streets and offers access to countless local shops, bars and amenities in Newcastle City Centre and the Quayside. Northumberland Street is close to bus, metro and rail links into other areas. The property is well presented and accommodation comprises; communal entrance with security video entry & private mail boxes, reception hallway, lounge, kitchen, two bedrooms (one with En Suite as well as the main Bathroom. The property is quadruple Glazed. Kitchen has dishwasher, washer/ dryer, electric hob and oven, electric heating. Bathroom has shower over bath and master bedroom with en suite shower room. Pre Wired for SKY, neutrally decorated and modern interior. Permit parking available. Student or professional property. To Arrange a viewing call My Property Box and speak to the Lettings Team.
